subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers fail closed on legacy ownerless session rows after upgrade, or should those rows receive a trusted migration path first?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes the persisted authorization and upgrade contract for ownerless rows; source review can verify implementation safety but cannot choose that compatibility policy for maintainers.

options.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
options.body: Require an exact persisted owner match for plugin-runtime patch and delete operations, leaving operator and non-plugin recovery paths available.

options.title: Migrate ownerless rows first
options.body: Add a trusted doctor or migration owner that assigns or repairs legacy rows before exact ownership enforcement becomes active.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
recommendation.body: Require an exact persisted owner match for plugin-runtime patch and delete operations, leaving operator and non-plugin recovery paths available.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session lifecycle and ownership-invariant work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility and security-boundary choice.
